{{External|rs|rsc=Willow Shortbow|dw=Willow Shortbow}} {{Infobox Item |name = Willow shortbow |image = [[File:Willow shortbow.png]] |release = [[25 March]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (25 March 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A shortbow made out of willow, still effective. |value = 200 |weight = 1.360 |exchange = Yes |id = 849 }} [[File:Willow shortbow detail.png|left|120px]] The '''willow shortbow''' is a two-handed ranged weapon stronger than the [[oak shortbow]], but weaker than the [[maple shortbow]]. It can use arrows up to [[mithril arrows|mithril]]. The willow shortbow requires a [[Ranged]] level of 20 or higher to wield. Players can purchase this bow from [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] in [[Varrock]]. [[Members]] can also make a willow shortbow through the [[Fletching]] skill at level 35. First, a player must cut an [[Willow shortbow (u)|unstrung willow shortbow]] from [[willow logs]], granting 33.3 Fletching [[experience]]. Then, the player must string the [[Willow shortbow (u)|unstrung willow shortbow]] with a [[bow string]], granting an additional 33.2 experience. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +20 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = 2h |speed = 4 |attackrange = 7 |combatstyle = Bow |image = [[File:Willow shortbow equipped.png]] |altimage = [[File:Willow shortbow equipped female.png]] }} {{CombatStyles|Bow|speed=4|attackrange=7}} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Fletching |skill1lvl = 35 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 33.2 |members = Yes |ticks = 2 |mat1 = Willow shortbow (u) |mat2 = Bow string |output1 = Willow shortbow }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Willow shortbow}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Willow shortbow}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 29 March 2005 |update = Weapons Update |change = The item was made available to free-to-play players. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 January 2005 |update = Slayer Skill |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Willow shortbow detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Willow shortbow detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Willow shortbow (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Willow shortbow.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
